title: unified-rollouts: weighted canary + metric-driven auto-rollback for model lifecycle
author: Ava Martinez
description:
Motivation: Provide a unified rollout primitive that supports weighted canaries, A/B, and shadow traffic while enabling metric-driven automated rollback. Current rollouts are fragmented across controllers (canary-only, shadow-only) and lack a single declarative policy that expresses weight schedules, metric thresholds, and automated rollback behavior. This PR introduces a RolloutPolicy schema, a planner that computes traffic weight transitions, and controller hooks for auto-rollback based on multiple metrics (latency P95, error rate, model quality regressions).

Changes: 1) API/schema: Add RolloutPolicy v1 with fields: strategy (weighted-canary | ab | shadow), weightSchedule (percentage/time steps), metrics (list of metric thresholds), rollbackPolicy (immediate | progressive | staged), and canaryHooks (pre/post-eval). 2) Controller: Implement rollout planner that drives traffic shifts via existing routing layer; supports simultaneous weighted splits over multiple backends and integrates with routing policies for dedicated/private deployments. 3) Auto-rollback: New evaluation engine that subscribes to telemetry streams (latency P95, 5xx rate, eval-based quality deltas) and triggers rollback when thresholds are breached for configured evaluation windows. 4) Telemetry & observability: New rollout-specific metrics (rollout_progress, planned_weight, observed_weight, rollback_event) and dashboard panels. 5) Tests & safety: End-to-end integration tests in perf-canary, unit tests for planner and rollback decision logic, and canary simulation harness. 6) Docs & examples: Console docs and a new quickstart for weighted canaries and A/B experiments.

Backward compatibility: RolloutPolicy v1 is additive; existing canary and shadow controllers remain functional. The routing API gained an optional weight param; default behavior unchanged. Migration notes included in release notes.

Rollout plan for merge: feature flagged behind "rollouts.v1". Default behavior off for all customers; opt-in via project config. Production rollout will start with internal tenants and then gradual enable for SRE-managed orgs.

Related tickets: ENG-6231 (planner), ENG-6240 (rollback engine), PM-1412 (product spec).

controller: rollout planner + weight applier + tests

review_comments: Rajesh Nair: Can we ensure the planner respects per-customer rate limits and doesn't oversubscribe dedicated capacity? Suggest adding a backpressure signal to the planner.
Ava Martinez: Added a planner backpressure check that consults capacity signals; see commit "planner: consult capacity backpressure". Also added unit tests to cover oversubscribe scenarios.

Lina Chen: The auto-rollback evaluation window default (3 min) seems short for noisy workloads. Recommend a configurable stabilization window and an exponential backoff for reattempting roll-forward after rollback.
Ava Martinez: Made the evalWindow configurable and added backoff policy for re-rollouts. Updated docs to call out sensible defaults for latency/error-based rollbacks.
Marco Alvarez: Integration tests look good. One nit: please add a short e2e scenario for shadow traffic with canaryHooks to validate no visible impact on serving latency.
Ava Martinez: Added e2e shadow scenario in perf-canary tests. All reviewers approved and requested squash merge.
merge_commit: squash: unified-rollouts weighted canary and auto-rollback [Ava Martinez]
release_notes: Add RolloutPolicy v1: weighted canaries, A/B, and shadow support with metric-driven automated rollback. Feature gated behind rollouts.v1; opt-in required. New telemetry metrics for rollouts and sample quickstart provided. See docs/rollouts/weighted-canary.md for migration and configuration guidance.
tests_run: unit: rollout planner and rollback logic
rollout_plan: Feature gated (rollouts.v1). Internal canary for 48h, then gradual enable for SRE-managed orgs. Default auto-rollback disabled for orgs unless explicitly configured. Auto-rollback triggers: P95 latency increase > 25% sustained for 3 minutes (configurable), 5xx error rate > 1% sustained for 2 minutes, or model-quality delta > configured threshold. Rollback algorithm: immediate rollback to previous stable variant; optional staged rollback if configured.
notes: This PR touches routing and controller code paths; ops runbook updated. Observability panels added under Console -> Rollouts. Coordinate with SRE before enabling in production.
